selection_policy: Selected after explicit prompt comparisons and visual review. Not a representative accuracy benchmark.

examples.name: organoids_im10
examples.review: Foreground agreement with the independent microSAM consensus mask; Dice 0.881.

examples.name: local-dendrite-spines
examples.review: Main shaft only. Spine-head candidates had low recall and are not shown.

examples.name: local-drosophila-olfactory-neuron
examples.review: Visually reviewed arbor foreground; no manual segmentation reference.

examples.name: public-skin
examples.review: Visually reviewed large histological layers; not a cell-level annotation.

examples.name: public-retina
examples.review: Optic disc only. The previous vessel prompt selected the retinal field and was rejected from the curated gallery.

examples.name: public-diatoms
examples.review: Distinct visible diatom shapes; overlapping label classes are intentional.

examples.name: public-embryos
examples.review: Complete visible embryo objects; the less convincing yolk label is omitted.

examples.name: local-CMU1-whole-section
examples.review: Overview of the entire acquired tissue scan; not a claim of DAB or cell-level segmentation.

examples.name: public-ki67-lymphoma-section
examples.review: Section outline only. DAB-positive nuclei are demonstrated separately at native resolution.

examples.name: local-mouse-brain-astrocytes-vessels
examples.review: A local green vessel profile replaces the previous near-whole-field prediction.

examples.name: public-lily-stem
examples.review: Visible green bundles are selected while the outer stem ring is excluded.

examples.name: public-neurofilament-network-roi
examples.review: Network-level foreground in a recorded Max-projection ROI; not individual axon tracing.

examples.name: public-ki67-brown-nuclei-detail
examples.review: A recorded native 192-pixel ROI distinguishes brown positive nuclei from blue negative tissue.

examples.name: public-em-mitolab-folded-mitochondria
examples.review: A native 2D EMPIAR patch with paired manual mitochondrial instance labels; selected after exploratory comparisons.

examples.name: public-em-mitolab-mitochondrial-cluster
examples.review: A second native 2D EMPIAR patch from the same acquisition; not an independent generalization benchmark.

examples.name: public-phase-paramecium-vacuoles
examples.review: Visible organism body and six bright circular interior structures. The two-contractile-vacuoles query selected the wrong structures and is excluded; circular masks are not validated contractile-vacuole identities.

examples.name: public-phase-paramecium-food
examples.review: Organism body and red carmine-containing food vacuoles. The black-vacuole query selected red structures and is excluded. No completeness claim for every small vacuole.

examples.name: public-em-chloroplast
examples.review: Central chloroplast outline and three visible dark round granules. The membrane-stack query returned no masks; the generic all-chloroplasts query selected granules instead. Neither is shown. Source-described false-colour TEM, without projection.

examples.name: public-fluorescence-endothelial
examples.review: Visible body of the large lower cell and its blue nucleus in the same view. The cell extends beyond the acquired left edge; the mask covers its visible portion. Fine red actin-network prompting was unsuccessful.

examples.name: public-fluorescence-kidney
examples.review: Two conspicuous right-side glomerular profiles in native optical section 8. Other profiles are missed; this is a selected qualitative demonstration, not complete glomerulus counting. Tubule/lumen queries and the smaller glomerulus ROI were not convincing.

examples.name: public-ihc-pancreatic-islet
examples.review: Whole central insulin-stained islet profile. Brown-cell prompting on this overview filled the entire islet instead of separating positive cells; that query is excluded. Publication JPEG, qualitative only.

examples.name: public-ihc-hyperplastic-islet
examples.review: Selected brown insulin-positive tissue regions within the published enlarged islet panel. Not individual positive-cell counts or validated stain quantification. The original arrow remains visible; whole-islet and lumen queries are excluded.
